dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High-contrast series of white spots forming distinct horizontal bands across dark greater and median coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Highly prominent sharp boundaries where white spotting interrupts the dark edges of folded primary and secondary feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Small, rectangular red patch visible on the posterior midline of the head.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp, linear color transition boundary between the black crown/nape and the white central mantle stripe.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, broad white longitudinal stripe extending vertically down the center of the mantle.
